name: Breville Dose Control Pro
details: Electric conical grinder with 60 settings (Sage in the UK and Europe).

rangeInfo.note: Honest Coffee Guide's chart (community, not the manufacturer's): Turkish 1–2, espresso 1–18, moka pot 17–44, AeroPress 13–60, V60 21–48, filter coffee machine 11–60, French press 48–60, cold brew 59–60. Its V60 row is used for pour-over, “Filter Coffee Machine” for drip, French press for immersion.
rangeInfo.estimateNote: Estimated by extrapolating the cited ranges, not from the source: Rapid Brewer: from the middle of the AeroPress range to the middle of the pour-over range. Dial in from there.
